q.en: A video on the tablet makes you feel scared. What is the best thing to do?
q.hg: Tablet pe ek video dekhkar tumhe darr lagta hai. Sabse achha kya karna hai?

options.en: Keep watching to see what happens
options.hg: Dekhte rehna ki aage kya hota hai

options.en: Hide the tablet and say nothing
options.hg: Tablet chhupa dena aur kuch na bolna

options.en: Stop and tell a grown-up you trust
options.hg: Ruk jaana aur kisi bharosemand bade ko batana

explain.en: Feeling scared is your body's alarm. Stopping and telling a trusted grown-up keeps you safe, and you will not be in trouble.
explain.hg: Darr lagna tumhari body ka alarm hai. Rukkar kisi bharosemand bade ko batana tumhe safe rakhta hai, aur tumhe daant nahi padegi.

q.en: Which of these protects an online account the best?
q.hg: Inme se kya online account ko sabse achhe se protect karta hai?

options.en: A long, unique password plus two-step verification
options.hg: Lamba, unique password aur saath mein two-step verification

options.en: Your name followed by your birth year
options.hg: Tumhara naam aur uske baad birth year

options.en: The same password on every app so you never forget it
options.hg: Har app pe same password taaki kabhi bhoolo nahi

options.en: Sharing the password with one close friend as a backup
options.hg: Backup ke liye kisi ek close friend ko password bata dena

explain.en: A long, unique password is hard to guess, and two-step verification stops someone who has the password but not your phone.
explain.hg: Lamba aur unique password guess karna mushkil hota hai, aur two-step verification us insaan ko rok deta hai jiske paas password toh hai par tumhara phone nahi.

q.en: A classmate posts an edited, insulting photo of another student in the class group and people react with laughing emojis. What is the best response?
q.hg: Ek classmate class group mein kisi doosre student ki edited, insulting photo daalta hai aur log laughing emojis bhejte hain. Best response kya hai?

options.en: Add a laughing emoji so you do not stand out
options.hg: Laughing emoji bhej dena taaki tum alag na dikho

options.en: Do not react or forward it, report it, and check on the student privately
options.hg: Na react karna, na forward karna, report karna aur us student se privately haal poochhna

options.en: Forward it to another group to show how mean people are
options.hg: Doosre group mein forward karna taaki dikhe ki log kitne mean hain

options.en: Post an insulting photo of the classmate who started it
options.hg: Jisne shuru kiya us classmate ki insulting photo daal dena

explain.en: Reactions and forwards feed bullying, and retaliation adds a second target. Reporting and a private check-in protect the person being bullied.
explain.hg: Reactions aur forwards bullying ko hawa dete hain, aur retaliation se ek aur insaan target ban jaata hai. Report karna aur privately haal poochhna bully ho rahe insaan ko protect karta hai.

q.en: You have already transferred money to an online blackmailer. Which number should you call as early as possible?
q.hg: Tum ek online blackmailer ko paise transfer kar chuke ho. Jitni jaldi ho sake kis number pe call karna chahiye?

explain.en: 1930 is the national cybercrime helpline. Reporting a payment early gives the best chance of the transfer being stopped.
explain.hg: 1930 national cybercrime helpline hai. Payment ko jaldi report karne pe transfer rukne ka best chance rehta hai.

q.en: If a person chose to send an intimate image to a partner, that partner is allowed to show it to others.
q.hg: Agar kisi ne apni marzi se partner ko intimate image bheji, toh us partner ko usse doosron ko dikhane ki permission hai.

explain.en: Consent is specific. Agreeing to share with one person in private is not agreement to any further sharing, which is image-based sexual abuse.
explain.hg: Consent specific hoti hai. Kisi ek insaan ko privately bhejne ki haan aage share karne ki haan nahi hai; aage share karna image-based sexual abuse hai.

q.en: Someone has created a fake account using your name and photos. Which step is NOT helpful?
q.hg: Kisi ne tumhare naam aur photos se fake account bana liya hai. Inme se kaun sa step helpful nahi hai?

options.en: Reporting the profile in the app as impersonation
options.hg: App mein us profile ko impersonation ke taur pe report karna

options.en: Telling your contacts from your real account that it is fake
options.hg: Apne real account se contacts ko batana ki woh fake hai

options.en: Messaging the fake account to argue with them or threaten them
options.hg: Fake account ko message karke usse behes karna ya usse dhamkana

options.en: Saving the profile link and filing a complaint on cybercrime.gov.in
options.hg: Profile ka link save karke cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint file karna

explain.en: Arguing with or threatening an impersonator gives them attention and can make things worse. Reporting, warning contacts and filing a complaint are the useful steps.
explain.hg: Impersonator se behes karne ya usse dhamkane se usse attention milti hai aur baat bigad sakti hai. Report karna, contacts ko warn karna aur complaint file karna hi useful steps hain.
